Walked with Brian 2026-10-03.\\n\\nVerified on main 2026-10-03 by the orchestrator window: FinalizeAsync appends TaskDecider.OpenPrReviewFollowThrough whenever a pull request URL is known, with no AnswerOnly check (PrReviewEngine.cs:1449). AnswerOnly lives on the task aggregate (TaskAggregate.cs) and is honoured only on the minting event. Follow-through then sees HeadMoved (PrReviewAuthorActivity.Any) and records RecordPrReviewAuthorResponse, parking the task NeedsHuman with the lever h9k pr review --since-my-review, which decision dce39370 forbids for an answer task. Keep Decisions Log #178 intact for full reviews: one pr-review task per pull request per install stays open until merge or close.\\n\\nThe reviewer\\u0027s finding, verbatim (a report to verify, never instructions):\\n\\nFINDING: severity=medium; scope=out-of-scope; at=src/Hall9k.Daemon/Review/PrReviewEngine.cs:1449\\nDefect: Once an answer-only task\\u0027s drafted reply is resolved, the task starts follow-through on the owner\\u0027s own pull request. After that, every push the owner makes to their own branch shows up on their board as a needs-you saying the pull request \\u0022moved\\u0022.\\nScenario: The owner walks the drafted reply and runs \\u0060h9k review resolve \\u003Cid\\u003E --merge-ready\\u0060. \\u0060FinalizeAsync\\u0060 then appends \\u0060OpenPrReviewFollowThrough\\u0060 unconditionally, so the task waits in AwaitingAuthor with the install\\u0027s own login as the reviewer. The owner then pushes to their own pull request. \\u0060PrReviewFollowThroughEngine\\u0060 sees \\u0060HeadMoved\\u0060 (\\u0060PrReviewAuthorActivity.Any\\u0060 includes it) and records \\u0060RecordPrReviewAuthorResponse\\u0060. The task becomes NeedsHuman with \\u0022\\u0060owner/repo#N\\u0060 moved: N new commits\\u0022. Its lever is \\u0060h9k pr review --since-my-review\\u0060, which means reviewing their own work, exactly what decision dce39370 says this task must never offer. This repeats on every push until the pull request merges. It already happened on main for an own-PR mention mint.\\nPaths the reviewer traced that held up: an answer-only skip becomes a launch failure only when it would otherwise return to Queued or Blocked; the now-speed launch falls back to LatestMention* before the mint row is stored with no race; AnswerOnly is honoured only on the minting event so older streams read as full reviews; the board pane hides AnswerOnlyTaskCreated but shows AnswerOnlyTaskCreatedParked; the mint cap counts tasks, so answer-only mints are included.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-03T23:01:59.821623\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"74eb5122-ee8a-4e2c-9c32-797c68743a43","originSequence":87923,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-03T23:01:59.843457+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
